## Publication Information

**Date:** 1878

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (Christmas 1878), 102-118.

**Notes:** The writer is described as author of 'Marling Hall' (a serial contributed anonymously to <i>London Society</i> in 1866) and 'William Hooper'.  Neither seems to have appeared in volume form.
